approval_scope: STAGE HUMAN REVIEW ENCRYPTION KEYS ONLY
key_material: Generate once with secrets.token_bytes(32), standard base64; never print or pass in command arguments
backup_required: Protected encrypted operator recovery copy outside repository, CLI history and logs, recoverable independently of SQL; no ADLS write authorized
abort_if: Unexpected existing key material/active ID, missing protected backup, concurrent config change, unhealthy app, inability to handle payload without disclosure
rollback: Before first capture only, restore original two settings and verify health; after any captured content retain every required key and use separately approved compatible rollback
do_not_run_during: Any temporary SQL resource protected by a watcher on this same Web App
